== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Lone Rogue, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 25 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of March 1, 2017” (PDF made 31 May 2017): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf DErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705005900/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: f62d406c26d63cbe2af93b20569678ee1bf07420. Shown on [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2017 slip)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/15/ESB2P-L-lonerogue-PC-Errata-2017-slip.png Internet Archive item].
